name: captchano-mcp
description: Solve reCAPTCHA v2/v3/Enterprise, Cloudflare Turnstile, DataDome and image captchas from AI agents.
long_description: CaptchaNo MCP server. Gives agents four tools: solve_captcha, get_task, get_balance and list_captcha_types. Solves run on CaptchaNo's own solving infrastructure and are billed to your CaptchaNo balance; failed solves are never billed. Use only on sites you are authorised to automate.

tools.name: solve_captcha
tools.description: Solve a reCAPTCHA, Turnstile, DataDome or image captcha and return the token, cookie or text.

tools.name: get_task
tools.description: Fetch the status and solution of a solve task by id.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Show the CaptchaNo balance and this session's spend.

tools.name: list_captcha_types
tools.description: List supported captcha types, their fields and how to find the sitekey.

api_key.title: CaptchaNo API key
api_key.description: Your CaptchaNo API key (starts with cn-). Create one at https://captchano.com/dashboard

max_spend_usd.title: Spend limit (USD, optional)
max_spend_usd.description: Stop solving once this session has spent this many US dollars. Leave empty for no limit.
